You can retrieve transaction records so you can build statements.
Use these endpoints to get transaction lists and statements:
- mccy/{vn}/Accounts/{accountId}/transactions
- mccy/{vn}/VirtualAccounts/{virtualAccountId}/transactions
- mccy/{vn}/StatementRequests
- mccy/{vn}/StatementRequests/account/{iban}
